quests.instruction: Which sea animal has a hard shell and two claws, and walks sideways?
quests.hint: It scuttles along the sand.
quests.explanation: A crab is a shellfish with a hard shell and pincers. Fish have scales and fins, and shrimp have long tails and thin legs.
quests.funFact: Crabs walk sideways because of the way their legs bend.

quests.instruction: Chocolate is made from the seeds of which tree?
quests.hint: Its seeds are called beans.
quests.explanation: Cacao trees grow pods full of seeds, and those seeds are turned into chocolate.
quests.funFact: Cacao trees grow in warm, rainy places near the equator.

quests.instruction: Ham and bacon come from which farm animal?
quests.hint: It rolls in mud to stay cool.
quests.explanation: Pigs are raised for pork, which includes ham and bacon. Sheep and goats are raised for other foods.
quests.funFact: Pigs roll in mud because they cannot sweat much, and the mud helps them cool down.

quests.instruction: What drink is a milk-like drink made from soybeans instead of from an animal?
quests.hint: It is made from soaked, ground beans.
quests.explanation: Soy milk comes from soybeans, which are legumes. Cow's milk and goat's milk come from animals.
quests.funFact: Many kinds of plant milk exist, including oat, rice and almond milk.

quests.instruction: On which kind of farm do grapes grow in long rows on vines?
quests.hint: Wires and posts hold the vines up.
quests.explanation: A vineyard is a farm for growing grapes. An orchard grows fruit trees and a dairy farm keeps cows.
quests.funFact: Grapes from vineyards are eaten fresh, dried into raisins or pressed into juice.

quests.instruction: Which tall grass is crushed to get the sweet juice that is made into sugar?
quests.hint: Its stalks are thick and juicy.
quests.explanation: Sugarcane stalks are pressed to squeeze out their sweet juice. Corn and rice are grains, not sugar plants.
quests.funFact: Sugar is also made from sugar beets, a root vegetable.

quests.instruction: Where would you see cows being milked each day?
quests.hint: Milk begins its trip to the shop here.
quests.explanation: A dairy farm keeps cows for their milk. An orchard has fruit trees and a bakery makes bread.
quests.funFact: Many dairy farms use milking machines, and cows are milked about twice a day.

quests.instruction: What do dairy cows mostly eat?
quests.hint: Cows graze out in the fields.
quests.explanation: Cows are plant-eaters, so they eat grass, hay and other plant foods.
quests.funFact: A cow's stomach has four parts that help it digest tough grass.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how chocolate is made, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Pods are picked, seeds are roasted, chocolate bars are made 🍫
options: Pods are picked, seeds are roasted, chocolate bars are made 🍫
Chocolate bars are made, pods are picked, seeds are roasted 🍫
Seeds are roasted, chocolate bars are made, pods are picked 🍫
quests.hint: Seeds must be picked before they can be roasted.
quests.explanation: Cacao pods are picked first, the seeds inside are roasted and ground, and then the paste is made into chocolate.
quests.funFact: Cacao pods grow right out of the trunk and thick branches of the tree.

quests.instruction: Which creamy white liquid is made by pressing the flesh of coconuts?
quests.hint: It is used in many curries and desserts.
quests.explanation: Pressing grated coconut flesh with water makes coconut milk. Cow's milk comes from animals and juice comes from fruit.
quests.funFact: Coconut milk is not the same as coconut water, which is the thin liquid inside a young coconut.

quests.instruction: Besides hens, which water bird lays eggs that people eat in many countries?
quests.hint: It paddles on ponds with webbed feet.
quests.explanation: Ducks lay eggs, and duck eggs are eaten in many places. Goats and cows give milk, not eggs.
quests.funFact: Duck eggs are usually a little bigger than chicken eggs.

quests.instruction: Which sea animal has eight arms and is eaten in many coastal places?
quests.hint: It has no shell at all.
quests.explanation: An octopus has a soft body and eight arms. Crabs and shrimp have hard shells.
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts.

quests.instruction: What do farmers call the time when they pick crops that are ripe and ready?
quests.hint: It happens after the crops have finished growing.
quests.explanation: Gathering ripe crops is called harvesting. Planting comes at the start and watering happens while crops grow.
quests.funFact: Many cultures hold festivals to celebrate the harvest.

quests.instruction: Mango and coconut grow on real trees. Which of these fruits grows on a giant plant that only looks like a tree?
quests.hint: Its soft trunk is made of tightly packed leaf bases.
quests.explanation: Banana plants have soft stems instead of wood, so they are giant herbs. Mangoes and coconuts grow on true trees.
quests.funFact: A banana plant can grow several meters tall in warm, wet places.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how eggs get from the farm to your kitchen, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Hen lays eggs, eggs are collected, eggs are packed in cartons 🥚
options: Eggs are packed in cartons, hen lays eggs, eggs are collected 🥚
Hen lays eggs, eggs are collected, eggs are packed in cartons 🥚
Eggs are collected, eggs are packed in cartons, hen lays eggs 🥚
quests.hint: A hen has to lay them first.
quests.explanation: The hen lays the eggs, the farmer collects them, and then they are packed for the shop.
quests.funFact: A hen usually lays one egg a day or less.

quests.instruction: What lunch is made only from foods that come from plants?
quests.hint: No animals are needed to make it.
quests.explanation: Rice and beans both grow on plants. Cheese comes from milk and eggs come from hens.
quests.funFact: Rice and beans together are a staple meal in many countries of Latin America and the Caribbean.

quests.instruction: A gardener plants carrot seeds. What do the seeds need next to start growing?
quests.hint: Plants cannot grow without a drink.
quests.explanation: Seeds need water to wake up and sprout. Salt would not help them and flour is already ground grain.
quests.funFact: Seeds can rest for a long time and only start to sprout once they get water and warmth.

quests.instruction: Which green vegetable grows as little round seeds lined up inside a pod?
quests.hint: You pop the pod open with your thumb.
quests.explanation: Peas grow inside pods. Corn grows as kernels on a cob and cucumbers grow as long fruits.
quests.funFact: A monk named Gregor Mendel grew pea plants to study how traits pass from parents to young.

quests.instruction: A sandwich holds bread, lettuce, tomato and ham. Which ingredient comes from an animal?
quests.hint: It is a type of meat.
quests.explanation: Ham is meat from a pig. Lettuce and tomato grow on plants.
quests.funFact: Ham is often cured with salt, which helps it keep for longer.

quests.instruction: A smoothie has bananas, strawberries and yogurt. Which ingredient started as milk?
quests.hint: It makes the smoothie thick and creamy.
quests.explanation: Yogurt is made from milk. Bananas and strawberries are fruits that grow on plants.
quests.funFact: Yogurt can be made from cow, goat or sheep milk, and even from plant milks.

quests.instruction: A pizza has dough, tomato sauce and basil. Which part starts as wheat?
quests.hint: It is the soft base that holds the toppings.
quests.explanation: Pizza dough is made from wheat flour. The sauce comes from tomatoes and basil is a leafy herb.
quests.funFact: Wheat flour contains a stretchy protein called gluten, which makes dough chewy.

quests.instruction: A breakfast plate has toast, eggs, butter and a glass of orange juice. Which item started as a fruit?
quests.hint: It was squeezed from something round and juicy.
quests.explanation: Orange juice is squeezed from oranges. Butter comes from cream and eggs come from hens.
quests.funFact: Orange trees are among the most widely grown fruit trees in the world.

quests.instruction: Which large farm bird has a fan-shaped tail and is a popular meal for celebrations in many homes?
quests.hint: It is bigger than a chicken and it gobbles.
quests.explanation: Turkeys are large farm birds that spread their tail feathers like a fan. Hens and ducks are smaller.
quests.funFact: A male turkey spreads its tail feathers like a fan to show off.

quests.instruction: Which food made from soybeans is pressed into soft white blocks?
quests.hint: It is a plant food, not a dairy food.
quests.explanation: Tofu is made from soybean milk that is curdled and pressed, so it is a plant food. Cheese and butter come from animal milk.
quests.funFact: Tofu has been made in East Asia for well over a thousand years.

quests.instruction: Which cooking oil is pressed from the seeds of a tall yellow flower?
quests.hint: The flower faces the sun all day.
quests.explanation: Sunflower seeds hold a lot of oil, which can be pressed out and used for cooking. Butter comes from cream and maple syrup comes from tree sap.
quests.funFact: Sunflower plants are grown in big fields around the world for their seeds and oil.

quests.instruction: Which list shows how raisins are made, in the right order?
quests.correctAnswer: Grapes grow, grapes are picked, grapes are dried 🍇
options: Grapes grow, grapes are picked, grapes are dried 🍇
Grapes are picked, grapes are dried, grapes grow 🍇
Grapes are dried, grapes grow, grapes are picked 🍇
quests.hint: Drying happens last.
quests.explanation: Grapes grow on vines, are picked when ripe and are then dried until they shrink into raisins.
quests.funFact: Raisins are sometimes dried in the sun on large trays.

quests.instruction: Where do hens sleep and lay their eggs on a farm?
quests.hint: It is a small house for birds.
quests.explanation: A coop is a small house for hens. A pond is for water birds and an orchard is for fruit trees.
quests.funFact: Hens like a perch called a roost to sleep on at night.

quests.instruction: Oranges and cherries both hang from tree branches. Which of these does not?
quests.hint: It grows below the soil.
quests.explanation: A carrot grows underground as a root, while oranges and cherries hang from branches.
quests.funFact: An orange tree can keep producing fruit for many years.

quests.instruction: Rice, wheat and corn are grains from grass-like plants. Which of these is not a grain?
quests.hint: It has layers of leaves, not seeds.
quests.explanation: Cabbage is a leafy vegetable. Rice and corn are grains.
quests.funFact: Rice, wheat and corn are among the most important crops for feeding people around the world.

quests.instruction: What meal has foods from both plants and animals?
quests.hint: Look for a meat in the meal.
quests.explanation: Chicken comes from an animal and rice grows on a plant, so the meal has both. Fruit salad and rice with beans come only from plants.
quests.funFact: Many traditional meals around the world pair a grain with a protein food.
